page.overview:
What is Martian ship?

This Martian ship, also called Martian warship or Martian vessel; was a warship used by the Martians. It was equipped with technology that was similar to a tractor beam that was described as "energy tendril" known as tethers. They were useful for salvaging ships for their war efforts against the Dol'drm.

Their weapon systems and propulsion systems were fairly primitive. The ship was armed with missiles and it wasn't warp-capable. But despite the fact that their ship lacked a transporter room they did have phasing technology. ()

In 2262, the encountered this ship when they were hurled millions of years into the past, to a time when Mars was still an inhabited M-class planet. The Martians stole antimatter from the Enterprise and used it as a weapon to destroy the homeworld of their enemies. The resulting shockwave from the explosion also consumed the Martian ship. ()
